title: Overview
description: Health of a self-hosted Supabase stack at a glance, laid out like Supabase Studio's Observability Overview.

panels.title: Targets down
panels.description: Scrape targets whose last scrape failed (up == 0). Storage pushes its metrics and has no scrape target, so it is not counted here.

panels.title: API server errors (1h)
panels.description: 5xx responses as a share of all gateway responses in the last hour. Shown only when the gateway answered at least 100 requests. Red from 1%, the rate in Supabase's "Measure API and Auth server errors" detection check.

panels.title: Auth server errors (1h)
panels.description: 5xx responses from Auth as a share of Auth responses in the last hour. Shown only when Auth answered at least 100 requests. Red from 1%, the rate in Supabase's "Measure API and Auth server errors" detection check.

panels.title: Connection pressure
panels.description: Client connections as a share of max_connections. Red from 80%, the threshold in Supabase's "Check connection pressure" detection check.

panels.title: Longest open transaction
panels.description: Age of the oldest transaction that is active or idle in transaction. Red from 30 seconds, the limit in Supabase's "Find long-running sessions and blockers" detection check.

panels.title: Inactive replication slots
panels.description: Replication slots that were inactive for the whole last 5 minutes. An inactive slot keeps WAL on disk until it is used again or dropped.

panels.title: Peak Connections
panels.description: Highest number of client connections in the selected time range, next to max_connections.

panels.title: Database size
panels.description: Size of the postgres database.

panels.title: Rollback ratio
panels.description: Rolled-back transactions as a share of all transactions in the postgres database in the selected time range.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of block reads served from shared buffers in the postgres database in the selected time range. There is no fixed good value; compare it with your own baseline.

panels.title: Deadlocks
panels.description: Deadlocks in the postgres database in the selected time range.

panels.title: Slot WAL headroom
panels.description: Smallest amount of WAL that can still be written before a replication slot is invalidated (safe_wal_size). Empty when there are no replication slots or when max_slot_wal_keep_size is -1 (no limit).

panels.title: Database Connections
panels.description: Client connections by role, stacked, against max_connections. Roles are named the way Supabase Studio names them.

panels.title: Service health
panels.description: Per-service totals for the selected time range, in the order Supabase Studio lists them. Status follows Studio: Unknown under 100 requests, Unhealthy at 1% errors or more, Healthy otherwise. Errors are 5xx responses. Latency is the 95th percentile in milliseconds.
